metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over Mayfield, Kentucky higher in November 2021 than on December 10-12, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: VIIRS DNB Black Marble Night Light "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" (monthly composites) - Date A: November 2021 (2021-11) - Date B: December 2021 (2021-12) – the 10-12 span is still fully captured by the monthly composite - Location: Mayfield, KY – build a small Point geometry around the city center 2. Masking strategy: monthly composites are cloud-free radiance, no cloud mask needed; just select the "avg_rad" band (nW cm⁻² sr⁻¹) 3. Logic: - Pull the two images (November 2021 and December 2021) → each month is a single-image collection - If either collection is empty → C1 - Sample mean radiance over a ~2 km buffer of Mayfield; after reduceRegion, confirm count > 0 (else C2) and value not None/NaN (else C3) - Compare: if Nov2021_mean > Dec2021_mean → A (Yes), else B (No) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Location & time definitions mayfield = ee.Geometry.Point([-88.6367, 36.7415]).buffer(2000) # 2 km buffer nov2021 = ('2021-11-01', '2021-12-01') # November composite dec2021 = ('2021-12-01', '2022-01-01') # December composite # 2. Acquire monthly Black Marble nightlight composites col = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG' nov_img = ee.ImageCollection(col).filterDate(*nov2021).select('avg_rad') dec_img = ee.ImageCollection(col).filterDate(*dec2021).select('avg_rad') # Check data presence if nov_img.size().getInfo() == 0 or dec_img.size().getInfo() == 0: print("Monthly composite missing for Nov or Dec 2021.") print("C1") else: # 3. Reduce to mean radiance nov_mean = nov_img.first().reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=mayfield, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() dec_mean = dec_img.first().reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=mayfield, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() # 4. Validation if nov_mean is None or dec_mean is None: print("C3") else: print(f"Nov2021 rad: {nov_mean:.2f} | Dec2021 rad: {dec_mean:.2f}") if nov_mean > dec_mean: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Location & time definitions
mayfield = ee.Geometry.Point([-88.6367, 36.7415]).buffer(2000)  # 2 km buffer
nov2021 = ('2021-11-01', '2021-12-01')   # November composite
dec2021 = ('2021-12-01', '2022-01-01')   # December composite

# 2. Acquire monthly Black Marble nightlight composites
col = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG'
nov_img = ee.ImageCollection(col).filterDate(*nov2021).select('avg_rad')
dec_img = ee.ImageCollection(col).filterDate(*dec2021).select('avg_rad')

# Check data presence
if nov_img.size().getInfo() == 0 or dec_img.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("Monthly composite missing for Nov or Dec 2021.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Reduce to mean radiance
    nov_mean = nov_img.first().reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=mayfield, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    dec_mean = dec_img.first().reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=mayfield, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    # 4. Validation
    if nov_mean is None or dec_mean is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"Nov2021 rad: {nov_mean:.2f} | Dec2021 rad: {dec_mean:.2f}")
        if nov_mean > dec_mean:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
